name: Alice Avery
source:
An exchange student from America, Alice is trying her best to fit in. Her strength and independent spirit help keep her optimistic, but when times get rough it's her passionate love of music that inspires her.

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters.html]official site[/url]]
